**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

Root cause: `dep-4471` (gateway, `a.novak`, `2026-03-14T02:12-02:14Z`) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` `false -> true`. Pool stayed capped at 20 connections, exhausted within seconds. Every 503 logs `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, waiting queue climbed from 13 to 74+.

Impact window: `2026-03-14T02:14:18Z` through end of log at `03:59:27Z`, unresolved, still erroring. Gateway only, hitting all backends (billing, orders, catalog, accounts). `worker.log` confirms workers were unaffected.

Rollback: revert `dep-4471`.
